Our Beginnings

Chicken Salad Chick was founded in 2008 by Stacy and Kevin Brown in Auburn, Alabama. Over time, they refined their recipe, turning their love for chicken salad into a thriving business. Today, Chicken Salad Chick stands proudly as the nation’s only fast-casual restaurant concept dedicated exclusively to fresh made chicken salad, offering a variety of flavors, along with sandwiches, fresh sides, gourmet soups, and delectable desserts. What sets Chicken Salad Chick apart is the personal touch that infuses every aspect of our menu. The unique flavors you see are more than just names—they represent real people who have touched Stacy’s life. Each named flavor is a tribute to these “real-life Chicks,” and through our menu, we celebrate their stories, allowing our guests to connect with and enjoy them as much as we do. At Chicken Salad Chick, it’s all about bringing people together, one scoop at a time.

Our Purpose

While we offer craveable, made-from scratch food and Southern hospitality in every restaurant, we say that our true purpose is to:

SPREAD JOY

Chicken Salad Chick serves full-flavored, Southern-style chicken salad made from scratch with fresh ingredients every day. With more than twelve original chicken salad flavors, fresh sides, gourmet soups, signature sandwiches, and delicious hand-frosted cakes, Chicken Salad Chick’s robust menu is a perfect fit that’s sure to bring a smile to every guest.

ENRICH LIVES

We pride ourselves on serving food from the heart, bringing the warmth of Southern hospitality to every recipe we prepare. Our restaurants are designed to have a welcoming atmosphere, and the service is always genuine. From the moment you walk through our doors, you’re greeted with friendly smiles and a commitment to making you feel right at home. Our team members go above and beyond to ensure that your experience is nothing short of exceptional. We believe in nurturing our guests with delicious food, heartfelt connections, and a sense of community that keeps you coming back for more.

SERVE OTHERS

Our restaurants are deeply committed to giving back to the communities we serve through various philanthropic initiatives. Each restaurant hosts a Friends & Family Event before the grand opening to raise funds for the local non-profit organization of their choice. We continue giving back through partnerships with schools, local businesses, hospitals, and other organizations to help our communities however we can.

America's Favorite Place for Chicken Salad

Under the leadership of CEO Scott Deviney, franchising has taken off in a major way. Chicken Salad Chick boasts over 300 restaurants in 22 states today. We offer craveable, made-from-scratch meals served from the heart to guests throughout the South, and are well on our way to be “America’s Favorite Place for Chicken Salad.”

About Chicken Salad Chick

More Than a Sandwich Franchise

Founded in 2008

At Chicken Salad Chick, we believe in spreading joy, enriching lives, and serving others - and it all starts with a scoop of chicken salad. Chicken Salad Chick was founded in 2008 by Stacy and Kevin Brown in Auburn, Alabama. Stacy began making her delicious chicken salad right in her home kitchen - earning her the nickname ‘Chicken Salad Chick.’ However, when the local county health department became aware, they mandated she close the business.

But that didn’tstop her spirit. After opening the first official Chicken Salad Chick restaurant, she began franchising in 2012. Today, Chicken Salad Chick has grown from a small home-based business into the nation’s only fast-casual, made from scratch chicken salad restaurant concept.

Over 300 Locations

With over 300 restaurants in 21 states, Chicken Salad Chick offers an unmatched experience featuring a wide variety of craveable, made-from-scratch chicken salad flavors, fresh sides, soups and sandwiches. Our menu is a celebration of the people who inspire us. Each flavor of chicken salad is named after a real life Chick who impacted Stacy’s life, making every scoop meaningful.

Contact Us
MORE THAN A BUSINESS - MAKE AN IMPACT

At Chicken Salad Chick, we do more than serve great food - we create an atmosphere where guests feel welcomed and appreciated. Our purpose is rooted in our three key principles:

SPREAD JOY

Chicken Salad Chick serves full-flavored, Southern-style chicken salad made from scratch with fresh ingredients every day. With more than twelve original chicken salad flavors, fresh sides, gourmet soups, signature sandwiches, and delicious hand-frosted cakes, there’s something for everyone to enjoy.

ENRICH LIVES

We believe in genuine Southern hospitality, where every visit feels like coming home. Our franchisees and their teams go above and beyond to make every guest experience special, fostering a sense of community.

SERVE OTHERS

Giving back is at the core of who we are. We challenge every new restaurant owner to partner with a local nonprofit organization during the Friends & Family soft opening event - but that’s not all. We strive to support schools, businesses, hospitals, and local organizations in every community we serve.

A FRESH TAKE ON
FRANCHISING
Simple Operations Model

We use fresh, high-quality ingredients and our products are made from scratch daily in our restaurants.

Top Notch Support 

We have the Leadership and support system in place to support you every step of the way!

Franchisee Family 

Our engaged franchise community meets multiple times a year, offering invaluable support and guidance as your business grow.

Closed on Sundays 

Our average restaurant is open from 10am-8pm Monday - Saturday. Our franchise offers work/life balance that allows our owners to keep a flexible lifestyle.

Our Beginnings

Chicken Salad Chick was founded in 2008 by Stacy and Kevin Brown in Auburn, Alabama. Over time, they refined their recipe, turning their love for chicken salad into a thriving business. Today, Chicken Salad Chick stands proudly as the nation’s only fast-casual restaurant concept dedicated exclusively to fresh made chicken salad, offering a variety of flavors, along with sandwiches, fresh sides, gourmet soups, and delectable desserts. What sets Chicken Salad Chick apart is the personal touch that infuses every aspect of our menu. The unique flavors you see are more than just names—they represent real people who have touched Stacy’s life. Each named flavor is a tribute to these “real-life Chicks,” and through our menu, we celebrate their stories, allowing our guests to connect with and enjoy them as much as we do. At Chicken Salad Chick, it’s all about bringing people together, one scoop at a time.

Our Purpose

While we offer craveable, made-from scratch food and Southern hospitality in every restaurant, we say that our true purpose is to:

SPREAD JOY

Chicken Salad Chick serves full-flavored, Southern-style chicken salad made from scratch with fresh ingredients every day. With more than twelve original chicken salad flavors, fresh sides, gourmet soups, signature sandwiches, and delicious hand-frosted cakes, Chicken Salad Chick’s robust menu is a perfect fit that’s sure to bring a smile to every guest.

ENRICH LIVES

We pride ourselves on serving food from the heart, bringing the warmth of Southern hospitality to every recipe we prepare. Our restaurants are designed to have a welcoming atmosphere, and the service is always genuine. From the moment you walk through our doors, you’re greeted with friendly smiles and a commitment to making you feel right at home. Our team members go above and beyond to ensure that your experience is nothing short of exceptional. We believe in nurturing our guests with delicious food, heartfelt connections, and a sense of community that keeps you coming back for more.

SERVE OTHERS

Our restaurants are deeply committed to giving back to the communities we serve through various philanthropic initiatives. Each restaurant hosts a Friends & Family Event before the grand opening to raise funds for the local non-profit organization of their choice. We continue giving back through partnerships with schools, local businesses, hospitals, and other organizations to help our communities however we can.

America's Favorite Place for Chicken Salad

Under the leadership of CEO Scott Deviney, franchising has taken off in a major way. Chicken Salad Chick boasts over 300 restaurants in 22 states today. We offer craveable, made-from-scratch meals served from the heart to guests throughout the South, and are well on our way to be “America’s Favorite Place for Chicken Salad.”

A vision with Purpose..
Co- founder Kevin Brown’s Legacy

The true purpose of our founders, Stacy and Kevin Brown, was to have a positive impact on people, and the duo saw the opportunity for a philanthropic avenue within just a few months of opening the first Chicken Salad Chick location. After Kevin’s diagnosis of stage 4 colon cancer that had spread to his liver, the direction of the Chicken Salad Chick Foundation became clear. Through fundraisers such as its annual Teeing Off On Cancer Golf Classic, the CSC Foundation is able to make sizeable donations to local cancer centers, as well as the American Cancer Society. The CSC Foundation hosted Music & Miracles Superfest in 2016 at Jordan-Hare Stadium featuring headliner Kenny Chesney plus Miranda Lambert, Sam Hunt, and Old Dominion, raising $200,000 for the Vanderbilt-Ingram Cancer Center.

After a courageous fight, Kevin passed away in November of 2015. He continued to devote his time to his family, the business, and the CSC Foundation right to the end.

In addition to finding a cure for cancer, the CSC Foundation is passionate about ending hunger in America. This cause is a natural fit for our foundation since, as a restaurant concept founded with an appreciation for health and family, feeding families in need closely aligns with who we are as an organization. Food insecurity affects one in six people in America, reaching every community in every state. The CSC Foundation partners with Chicken Salad Chick locations in our various markets to give back to local food banks and food-related charities.

True to our mission of spreading joy, enriching lives, and serving others, we’re honored to have the ability to give back through our Chicken Salad Chick Foundation. Through this foundation, we have tremendous opportunities to impact the lives of our friends and neighbors in need and, in doing so, help secure the future of our philanthropy by setting a positive example across the Chicken Salad Chick organization. Whether fighting cancer or feeding the hungry, this foundation allows us to affect the lives of so many in our communities, as well as on a much broader level.
